**Inviolate Form (Su):** At 17th level, you cannot age or be magically aged; you gain no bonuses or penalties for aging and do not die from old age. You are immune to negative energy damage and death effects and can spend 4 ki points to end a spell or effect that would penalize or stop your attacks or movement. This ability replaces timeless body and tongue of the sun and moon.
